name: PingOne LAB
description: One shelf with a card for each thing PingOne can do for apps and AI agents (only what its discovery document advertises): pi.flow sign-in, PKCE, PAR, JAR, client credentials, token lifecycle, Userinfo, device authorization, CIBA, token exchange and a protocol playground. Runs on a built-in mock PingOne (offline) or your own PingOne environment (live).
notes: Host-run: npm install && npm run build && npm start (port 5500, loopback only; mock mode needs no settings). Docker: copy .env.example to .env, then docker compose up --build -d (publishes 127.0.0.1:5500 only, https). Catalog id A29 is proposed (PROPOSED-CATALOG-ROWS-LABS-2026-10-31.md); renumber here and in content-pack.json if the owner changes it.
